[quote=sal-baliz;59178269][b]An Oligarchic Mystery[/b]

Supreme Leader Falah is sitting in a small underground compound, reviewing the latest reports from SummitONE, when suddenly there is a knock at the door. He gets up and makes his way over to find that a small letter has been slid under the door. There is a strange marking on it, representing an oligarch. The letter reads as follows : 

"Goodday old pal, Sikirsk is lost, but we oligarchs have one last act. If you open the door there should be a small box, in this letter there should be a key to open it, open the box with the key, then look inside, there you shall see two tickets. One for a flight in Thyven, and one for a flight to North Thyven. Use them wisely.

- Codename: Old Yugorsk"

Falah's signature evil smile spread across his face as the contents of the letter sunk in. After the humiliating defeat of the ARoS, the Sal-Baliz had become worried, fearing that Thyven may uncover their secrets, but the news that the Oligarchs were still alive had just given them a renewed surge of hope. The question of where the remaining Oligarchs were residing remained a mystery, so the high command ordered an immediate investigation. Flight records from the past month were scrutinised to their limit and camera feeds reviewed ten times over. After a week of digging deep into the depths of information, the team managed to track the letter to a small apartment in Stormhaven, Norrhollow. Falah could not risk travelling himself, so instead he ordered that a small group of operatives be sent to norrhollow. The team used the ticket to North Thyven, then took a bus through Schodenia and finally a boat to Norrhollow. Instructions would be relayed through a complex series of USB stick exchanges and would eventually arrive at the operatives, two days after landing in Norrhollow. Their instructions gave them the address to the apartment and they were ordered to meet with the Oligarchs in order to discuss a naval offensive on THEP and their allies.

[nation]Sikirsk[/nation]
[nation]Norrhollow[/nation]
[nation]The Crystalline Empire[/nation]
[nation]North Thyven[/nation]

[nation]Shahzada[/nation] RP[/quote]

On the morning of April 20th, Akmal Mannan and Rafi Hamidi, the two leading members of the team in Norrhollow made their way to the Apartment. They wandered through the cobbled streets of stromhaven, the morning sun glistening in their faces, for around 25 minutes, before they managed to find the address. Along the way they spoke in albic rather than their native tongue, so as to not attract attention. They also wore standard Norrhollower clothing for the same reason. When they reached the apartment, Akmal stepped forwards and knocked on the door.  By this time, rush hour was over and most Norrhollowers had made their way to work, so they were hoping that the oligarchs would be the only ones in the building.
"Hello? Anybody there?" he called out.
